campaign.title: Rename G40_02_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_02_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_02_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_02_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 104) THEN
    G40_02_PROVIDER = 104
  END IF
  G40_02_PROVIDER = G40_02_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_02_PRED_1(X)
  G40_02_PRED_1 = 0

    G40_02_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_02_PRED_1 = G40_02_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_02_PRED_2(X)
  G40_02_PRED_2 = 0

  END IF
  G40_02_PRED_2 = G40_02_PRED_2
END FUNCTION
